scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/student" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/console" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/superadmin"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/student && npm run build --workspace=apps/console && npm run build --workspace=apps/superadmin
scripts.migrate:tenant: cd apps/api && npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register scripts/migrate-tenant.ts
scripts.migrate:cleanup: cd apps/api && npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register scripts/migrate-tenant-cleanup.ts
